# Alerts

GitHub-style admonitions use `> [!TYPE]` as the first line of a blockquote.

> [!NOTE]
> Useful information that is not a warning. The sidebar tree and live reload
> are good examples of things to mention here.

> [!TIP]
> Click an image or a Mermaid diagram to open the zoom overlay. Left-click drag
> pans; the wheel zooms; Escape closes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Relative markdown links stay inside the viewer. External `http://` / `https://`
> links open in a new tab.

> [!WARNING]
> Frontmatter (`---` / `+++`) is stripped before render. It will not appear in
> the preview. See [nested/linked.md](nested/linked.md) for an example.

> [!CAUTION]
> Raw HTML in markdown is passed through. Treat local content as trusted.
